decisions.reason: The pixelation constraint applies specifically to full-page chapter images; it does not change the interior layout requirement's trim size, publication format, or general layout obligation.
Image rendering quality does not alter the Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or body-text formatting rules.
Checking full-page chapter images for pixelation does not affect table-of-contents page numbers or their update timing.
The source decision concerns chapter-image rendering and does not change the copyright-page publisher line or layout.
The pixelation check for full-page chapter images neither resolves nor changes the uncertainty about whether the interior title page should contain an image.
Chapter-image pixelation is unrelated to the prohibition on a literal newline artifact in the book title.
Messages 97-99 refer to full-page chapter images, not the paperback cover; the cover's content, format, and trim-size requirements remain unchanged.
The chapter-image rendering constraint does not affect preparation of back matter or author copy.
The pixelation requirement concerns illustration rendering and does not change manuscript wording, editing goals, or approved passages.
